segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good morning. Good morning, Senator Marcos. segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you. The Chair would like to give his opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Today, as we scrutinize the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Budget and Management and the special purpose funds, we do so in light of the recent landmark decision of the Supreme Court concerning the constitutionality of certain provisions under previous and present General Appropriations Acts. Bagamat hindi dineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional ang unprogrammed appropriations, malinaw ang naging paalala nito sa Kongreso. We have a constitutional duty to exercise fiscal discipline,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: uphold transparency and accountability, and ensure that every appropriation complies with the mandates of our Constitution. Malinaw po sa inyong lingkod at sa committee na ito ang ating tungkulin. We must ensure that the national budget is not only fiscally sound and responsive to the needs of our people, but also fully compliant with the Constitution. In its decision, the Supreme Court reminded us

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: of the fundamental responsibility that comes with the power of the purse. Every peso collected in taxes and fees represents labor rendered, needs deferred, perseverance and sacrifice endured by our people. The General Appropriations Act [unclear] that sacrifice. This should guide us throughout our deliberations and remind us that the power of appropriations is not without limits, especially in light of the provisions provided in the 1987 Constitution.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya naman po mahalaga ang papel ng DBM sa landmark desisyon na ito. Bukod sa 2.9 bilyon na pondo ng ahensya, ang DBM ay responsable din sa management ng higit-kumulang 550 billion na special purpose funds at unprogrammed appropriations. Nais nating malaman ngayong araw: una, ano ang implikasyon ng desisyon ng Korte Suprema sa binabalangkas nating national budget para sa Fiscal Year 2027?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pangalawa, anong adjustments ang kailangan nating baguhin sa kasalukuyang version ng budget upang maiwasan ang anumang constitutional infirmities? Our responsibility does not end with determining how much the government may spend. We must also ensure that public funds are appropriated for clearly defined purposes, supported by available resources, and subject to proper safeguards and accountability.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa madaling salita, hindi sapat na may pondong inilaan. Kailangan malinaw kung saan ito gagamitin, paano ito popondohan, sino ang makikinabang, at paano natin matitiyak na ito ay magagamit nang tama at wasto. At the start of our budget deliberations in the Senate, this representation emphasized our commitment to passing a national budget that responds to the basic needs of our people. Today, as we conduct the last day of budget briefing before sponsoring the proposed

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: 2027 national budget, allow me to reaffirm that commitment and underscore an equally important responsibility: to ensure that the budget we pass can stand constitutional scrutiny, reflects sound fiscal management, and delivers meaningful and tangible benefits to the Filipino people. Thank you very much. At this point, the Chair would like to acknowledge Senator Marcos for her opening statement.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the Department of Budget and Management is proposing 3.125 billion to support public financial management, procurement reform, digital transformation, transparency, and organizational efficiency.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: This may be a relatively modest budget compared with those of our largest departments, but the DBM carries a mandate that cuts across the entire bureaucracy.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Its work affects practically every department, every program, and every peso in the national budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At the heart of its mandate is a simple principle. Every peso of public money must be properly allocated, prudently spent, transparently managed, and fully accounted for.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The DBM pursues this through three pillars. Fiscal discipline, effective resource allocation, and efficient government operations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In practical terms, government must spend within its means, put resources where they are needed the most, and continuously improve the way it operates.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And these are not standards that DBM imposes only on other agencies. They are also reflected on the DBM's own budget.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, we will furnish the Senator the detailed utilization of the N-Program.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kababawan lang ito. Itatanong ko lang kasi binakita mo dito sa accomplishment ng first semester.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Meron lang kayong continuing appropriation of 598.28 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I assume this is from 2025. This continues to be available for obligation up to the end of the year.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: 184 million pa lang ang nga na-o-obligate.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: What's the obligation figure that you have that's best updated?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, we confirmed the figure 598.28 under continuing appropriations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Although we would like to submit na most of these...

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pero yung second to the last column, kayo rin nagbigay. 30.77 lang ang obligation.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That is correct, Your Honor. We reviewed the projects that are covered by these...

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Continuing appropriations. In fact, yung iba po dito ay na-offer na doon po sa savings under the National Budget Circular 602 and 603.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, kailangan lang po itong ma-update kasi yung mga negative saros po were issued after the cut-off of the reporting, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Nanghihinayang lang kami. Sayang yung pondo.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I-re-revert ba ito to Treasury? Nasa fourth quarter na tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ano bang programs and projects funded by the Treasury?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: By this continuing approach. At bakit hindi magastos?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, as mentioned, kami rin po nanghihinayang.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That's why, yun nga po, nagaya po nang nabanggit ko, in-offer po namin ito as savings para makatulong po doon sa ating uplift intervention.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That is also the same reason why, Your Honor, the DBM's budget is lower in 2027.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Dahil alam po namin na yung 2026 po namin, meron pa kaming magiging continuing.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So we are really looking at re-priority.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ano ba talaga ito? Can you give us an idea? Kagilagilalas yung hindi nagagastos yung pera, naging bato pa.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Meron po tayo, Your Honor, na nakitang ini-implement natin na several projects under the Public Financial Management Program of the DBM.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At ito po ay kabilang sa ating mga nire-review. Na bakit nga po ba hindi ito ma-implement?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Sa tinirin ninyo ang recipient nito.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Precisely, Your Honor. So we're also doing internal review and housekeeping in terms of our own projects, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We are checking whether kailangan po ba talaga itong mga projects na ito na maipagpatuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Hindi. Umabot na tayo ng halos November. Hindi pa nagagastos.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Again, Your Honor, that is precisely the reason behind us approving a lower budget for DBM for 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pagkatapos sa with the Supreme Court decision, baka kasama na ito.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Isa po yun sa bahagi ng clarification na paglilino po na ating hihingin po patungkol sa desisyon, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Okay. Marami na akong tanong. Maraming salamat. Magsusunod na round na lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, Sector Marcos, our Senate President. You may already ask your questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I think ang pinaka...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: ...news of the day ngayon, yung Supreme Court ruling.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And in fact, the Supreme Court ruling gave some directions and clarity, pero marami rin mga questions pagdating sa crafting of the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll ask the questions later on. Pero I want to ask the Secretary, with this Supreme Court ruling on the unprogrammed funds,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: and narinig ko kanina sa nag-umpisa na kayo and your team to go through the Supreme Court ruling.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Makapal siya. I also went through it or tried to go through it this morning.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But what can you now... We're now in the thick of the budget process.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, sabi nga ng ating chairman, patapos na kami and we're going to enter into consolidation of the different budgets...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: ...of different agencies. And then from there, magpa-plenary debates na kami.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So what are the recommendations of the DBM in relation to the Supreme Court ruling so that we can already fine-tune, we can already adjust, we can already watch out for kung merong mga kailangan kaming tignan mabuti.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang dapat naming i-adjust dito sa 2027 budget process.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, Mr. Senate President.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: There are things that are indeed very clear in the decision.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And we are also happy to report that for one, when the Supreme Court ruled on the unconstitutionality of the SAGIP, we don't have SAGIP anymore even in the 2027 unprogrammed appropriations.

segments.text: Because the amount we arrived at for that particular entry, meron naman pong pinanggalingan ng mga pipeline projects. So we stand ready to help Congress in complying with that guardrail by giving the breakdown kung paano po ba namin nakuha yung support to foreign assisted projects.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We have also, as we have reported, listed down fewer items sa ating UA for 2027. Yun nga lang po, Mr. Chair, Mr. Senate President, there are just some items which I think is also crucial in the budget legislation phase, particularly the declaration on the unconstitutionality of one of the triggers for unprogrammed appropriations.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But again, we reserve, as earlier pronounced, how this can be best interpreted and applied moving forward. But one thing we can assure is the Executive is not releasing anything as of now triggered by Sections 1A and 1B as covered by the Supreme Court decision.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We also welcome if Congress, as mentioned by the Supreme Court decision, will include more details or suggestions.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Or safeguards or requirements that will guide the Executive in further executing the unprogrammed appropriations. Maybe more parameters if necessary para po makumply natin yung four guardrails as stated by the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Because we note that there was also a provision in the decision, a reference about approving authority. So we submit to the wisdom of Congress and the Senate as well in further defining these conditions, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So basically, ang sinasabi ng Supreme Court is hindi pwedeng lumampas ang Kongreso doon sa NEP proposal ng Presidente for programmed and unprogrammed.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I think that's bottom line. That is one of the most important direction. And of course, nakasulat rin doon yung mga transparency.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We also engage civil society movements in the budget, which we have done in the 2026 budget. In fact, lahat yan ay uploaded sa website. And we also engage civil society organizations.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And patuloy namin sini-engage. In fact, kahapon sa hearing ni Sen. Pangilina, nandun yung civil society organizations sharing their analysis.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So it's not only us analyzing, but we also engage third-party analysis through the civil society.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So bottom line, hindi pwedeng lumampas ang Kongreso sa proposal ng Presidente, both unprogrammed and programmed. Bottom line.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That is how we view the decision, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But what is clear right now, even unprogrammed.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Even unprogrammed. Kasi that was the debate.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Unprogrammed, hindi nga lumalampas. Pero yung unprogrammed, sobrang-sobrang na lumalampas.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: For example, in 2024, ang NEP 281, unprogrammed to, 281, biglang naging 731 yung final sa unprogrammed.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In 2025, ganun rin, 158 billion yung NEP. Pagdating sa final is 363.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So it's only itong 2026 na correct. Ang proposal is 249.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang final is 150. So bumaba sa proposal ng Presidente.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll go to some specifics because this is important in the way we will craft the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Doon sa decision ng Supreme Court, pinagbawal niya o ginawa niyang unconstitutional yung special provision 1A and 1B.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So ang ibig sabihin niyan, dito sa unprogrammed na gagawin for 2027, FAPS lang ang matitira.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama? Actually, nawala na yung essence of new revenue and new taxes. Nawala na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang sinasabi, the way we understand it, in fact, I'm consulting our LBRMO, the way we understand it, foreign-assisted projects na lang ang matitira.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Sa presentation ninyo, meron pang restoration ng PDIC, merong conversion of national government agencies sa unprogrammed. Lahat yung mawawala na.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, the way we understood and the way we read, again, subject to the alignment later on with the Office of the Solicitor General,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: meron pa naman pong possibility for that but ang sabi po sa decision, the reference is dapat yung excess is from the totality of the revenue.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: What was particularly covered by the decision was the reference in any one, excess in any one item po. Yun po yung reference to Section 1A.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, the initial view, Your Honor, is pwede pa namang kung may excess but the excess is to be determined from the total target.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun po yung initial reading po ng team doon sa decision, subject nga po doon sa mapag-uusapan on the items to be clarified or to be respected.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But yung 1B is the totality. Diba, 1B is new revenue collection arising from taxes or non-tax.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: New over and above the PSF levels.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yes. Oo. So, etatlo lang naman yung sa special provision, diba?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That is correct. There are only three triggers.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Three triggers lang. Kung tinanggal mo yung dalawa, matitira yung foreign assistant.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The unprogrammed is only designed for foreign assistant.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, the point I'm trying to make is we don't want to approve a budget here that is unconstitutional.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Although our legal teams here are also studying it, but we're also seeking guidance from DBM because we don't want to pass a version wherein unconstitutional siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: For sure, tatanggalin na namin yung 1A and 1B.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: As a clarification, probably, yun nga po ang discussion ng team is the excess can still be triggered.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Probably, pwedeng i-correct yung base. That's an initial reading.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, mag-i-introduce ulit ng isa pang special provision.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi those are the triggers. Without those triggers, you cannot trigger the unprogrammed.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The source of the unprogrammed is new revenue.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We commit to work with the Senate and Congress to fine-tune the special provision for unprogrammed to make sure we will fully subscribe and follow the Supreme Court decision.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: That's why kanina sabi ko may clarity, mayroon rin mga questions na lumabas doon sa decisions that we want to also work with the DBM on how to do that.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We keep talking about the unconstitutionality of 2024 and 2025 GAA, but there's also mention of 2026 nga.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, is your understanding that 2026 was also struck down as unconstitutional or merely the special provisions 1A, 1B under said chapter?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, unlike 2024 and 2025, yung 2026 po wala pong specific mention that the entire GAA was declared unconstitutional.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: They didn't say it was unconstitutional.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Only limited to section 1A and 1B of the UA, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we'll, again, internally we're working.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'm also consulting our chairman about that because we don't want to come up with a committee report na yung...

segments.text: Quickly mention, Your Honor, the seven pillars.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Budget reliability, transparency of public finances, management of assets and liabilities,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: fiscal strategy and budgeting, predictability and control in execution,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: accounting and reporting, and external scrutiny and audit.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Okay, so lahat yun dapat compliance siya before siya maging eligible.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Actually, dito, Your Honor, wala pa pong metric on compliance.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: It starts from an assessment benchmark.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, the assessment tool gives them where they are now,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and the improvement plan is the direction where they want to go.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yes, go ahead. Center on me.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Diba yun yung binanggit mo na hindi ninyo magastos-gastos kanina,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: yung continuing appropriations, yung public financial management,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: yung sinasabi mo, e diba, nagtataka ko, hindi nga magastos ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Sabi mo, yung nandyan, yung PFM na sinasabi mo kanina na under review ng DBM,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: kasi hindi magastos-gastos, na nasa 30% lang kayong disbursed ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ay, hindi pala disbursed, obligated nga lang.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, PFM is a program.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, what we are reviewing is one component, one particular platform under PFM,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and that is the Budget Treasury Management System, BTMS.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, ito po ay subsets, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I understand, but it's just confusing that you're going to use a tool that, in fact, isn't working.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, these are different tools, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: But you just said PFM. It's the same thing you said earlier.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Because PFM, Your Honor, is a set of principles.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, BTMS is just one of the IT systems, the tools that we are using

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: so that we can gather information on a more real-time or more granular basis.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But these are two different systems, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I know matagal na itong LGSF, but last year lang or this year lang ginawang a major program ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Again, we don't want it to be an arbitrary political tool.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: What we want is for good governance to flourish, for good financial housekeeping to flourish,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: and this is a good incentive for them.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Certainly, Your Honor. We'd be happy to work with that.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Let's sharpen your tools so that the local government units may incentive sila na ayusin yung libro nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dapat halos wala or minimal yung observation ng COA.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, may mga ganyan. Yan ang talagang direction before when we included that in the special provision.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I think, siguro, since nawala na yung PIDA for Countrywide Development Fund before,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: ang intention nun was to distribute yung resources evenly.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But I think this one, if implemented properly,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: our President and myself being former mayors, this will really incentivize our LGUs to perform better.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tsaka maganda na sila. They will be rewarded for their performance.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At the same time, we are also distributing the resources in the different parts.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yun lang. Kailangan lang natin. Ang ano natin dito is to make sure that this will not be viewed as a port.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kailangan. I think it will be the DBM who has that challenge to make sure that it will be evenly and fairly distributed.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tsaka yung criteria will be fairly judged. Thank you, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung NTF-LCAC is also part of the funds that you manage.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi I remember when we were discussing itong NTF-LCAC, Director,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: every year nag-a-allocate tayo ng 8 billion.

segments.speaker: NTF-ELCAC Director for Planning and Production Alexander S. Umpar
segments.text: Sir, yung funding po ng NTF-LCAC, nag-iiba.

segments.speaker: NTF-ELCAC Director for Planning and Production Alexander S. Umpar
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama. So this year, ilan ang baranggays ang target natin?

segments.speaker: NTF-ELCAC Director for Planning and Production Alexander S. Umpar
segments.text: For 2027, Your Honor, it's around 1,948 baranggays.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: 948. And that is actually the question, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi theoretically, ginagamit natin itong pondo to clear baranggays.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: This is a baranggay clearing program.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Actually, Your Honor, these are already cleared baranggays.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Before they can get the funds, they should have been certified as cleared by the NTF-LCAC.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And the funds are supposed to maintain that status of being cleared.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: To provide opportunities for these cleared baranggays to have more economic activities,
